# Prodigy Game

> Prodigy is a curriculum-aligned, game-based learning platform that makes math and English education engaging through adaptive gameplay and student progress tracking.

Prodigy Game offers free and premium game-based learning solutions for students in grades 1-8, serving teachers, parents, and learners with standards-aligned content in math and English. The platform combines gamification with educational rigor to improve student engagement and learning outcomes.

## Core Products

- [Prodigy Math](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/prodigy-math): Adaptive game-based learning in fantasy world for grades 1-8
- [Prodigy English Game](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/prodigy-english): Game-based reading and language skills development for grades 1-6
- [Math Facts Practice](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/math-facts-practice): Free, customizable math fluency tool that builds skills without stress
- [Prodigy Home](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en): Main platform homepage: curriculum-aligned game-based math learning

## For Teachers & Educators

- [Prodigy for Educators](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/teachers): Free standards-aligned adaptive math game with teacher tools for grades 1-8
- [Teacher Resources](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/resources): Free teacher guides, worksheets, and professional development materials
- [English Curriculum Standards](https://www.prodigygame.com/main-en/english-language-curriculum-standards): Prodigy English Common Core standards alignment for grades 1-6

## For Parents & Families
